required_capabilities: Create Wall (×1); Create Door (×1); Create Window (×1); Delete Element (×2); Inspect Project (×1)
instruction: The floor plan shown in the attached drawing has already been built in the current model. The drawing carries redline annotations marking the required design changes: every RED door, window, and wall is an element that must be ADDED to the model, and every element marked with a RED CROSS must be DELETED. Create the red elements at the marked positions - for the added door, match the swing shown in the drawing, including the hinge side and whether it opens into or out of the room - delete the crossed-out ones, and do not touch any unmarked element.
